meta.note: The grammar dictionary, Lingvo-style: twelve reference articles on the traps a learner actually falls into, rendered through the same entry UI as any word — meanings become bullet points, collocations become the examples.

meanings.trans: ser — what something IS: identity, profession, origin, character
meanings.note: Sou analista. Ela é do Porto. O mar é salgado.

meanings.trans: estar — how something IS RIGHT NOW: state, place, mood
meanings.note: Estou cansado. O café está frio. Estamos no Funchal.

meanings.trans: the pair that proves it
meanings.note: A sopa é boa (good soup as such) / A sopa está boa (came out well today)

meanings.trans: permanent place uses ficar or ser
meanings.note: O banco fica na esquina.

collocations.trans: to be from / made of / belong to

entry.grammar: Rule of thumb: if tomorrow it can be different — estar. If it defines the thing — ser.

cards.note: grammar reference — open 📖 for the full article

meanings.trans: para — direction, purpose, deadline, recipient
meanings.note: Vou para casa. Isto é para ti. Para sexta.

meanings.trans: por — cause, exchange, route, duration, 'per'
meanings.note: Obrigado por tudo. Paguei 10 € por isto. Fui pelo túnel.

meanings.trans: the minimal pair
meanings.note: Faço-o para ti (for your benefit) / Faço-o por ti (in your place, because of you)

entry.grammar: para looks forward (goal); por looks backward or around (cause, path, price).

cards.note: grammar reference — open 📖 for the full article

meanings.trans: de + o/a/os/as → do, da, dos, das
meanings.note: o carro do vizinho

meanings.trans: em + o/a → no, na (nos, nas)
meanings.note: Estou no café. Moro na Madeira.

meanings.trans: a + o/a → ao, à (aos, às)
meanings.note: Vou ao mercado às nove.

meanings.trans: por + o/a → pelo, pela
meanings.note: Obrigado pela ajuda.

meanings.trans: de/em + um → dum, num (colloquial but standard pt-PT)
meanings.note: Moro num T2.

entry.grammar: Contractions are mandatory, not stylistic: 'em o café' is simply wrong.

cards.note: grammar reference — open 📖 for the full article

meanings.trans: default pt-PT: AFTER the verb, with a hyphen
meanings.note: Diz-me. Vi-o ontem. Dá-lhe o livro.

meanings.trans: magnets pull it BEFORE: não, que, quem, já, também, sempre, talvez
meanings.note: Não me digas! Acho que te vi.

meanings.trans: future/conditional split the verb (mesoclisis, formal)
meanings.note: Dir-te-ei amanhã — in writing; speech says 'vou dizer-te'

meanings.trans: Brazilian default is before the verb — the giveaway
meanings.note: 'Me diz' sounds Brazilian; Portugal says 'Diz-me'

entry.grammar: When in doubt in Portugal: verb first, pronoun after — unless a 'magnet word' stands before the verb.

cards.note: grammar reference — open 📖 for the full article

meanings.trans: wishes and emotions: querer que, esperar que, ter medo que
meanings.note: Espero que corras bem no exame.

meanings.trans: doubt and denial: talvez, duvido que, não acho que
meanings.note: Talvez chova logo.

meanings.trans: after certain conjunctions: embora, para que, antes que
meanings.note: Embora seja caro, vale a pena.

meanings.trans: the future one after quando/se/assim que (futuro do conjuntivo)
meanings.note: Quando puderes, liga-me. Se vieres, avisa.

entry.grammar: If the event is wished, doubted or not yet real — conjuntivo. Facts get the indicativo.

meanings.trans: an infinitive that conjugates: falares, falarmos, falarem
meanings.note: É melhor falarmos amanhã.

meanings.trans: after para / antes de / depois de with its own subject
meanings.note: Trouxe o mapa para não nos perdermos.

meanings.trans: looks like futuro do conjuntivo for regular verbs
meanings.note: same forms, different job

entry.grammar: Portuguese's own invention — no other Romance language conjugates the infinitive.

meanings.trans: tu + 2nd person verb — friends, family, colleagues your age
meanings.note: Tu falas bem!

meanings.trans: o senhor / a senhora — respectful to strangers, elders
meanings.note: O senhor pode ajudar-me?

meanings.trans: você exists but is tricky in Portugal — often too blunt
meanings.note: safer: drop the pronoun, use 3rd person verb: 'Pode ajudar-me?'

meanings.trans: verb alone carries politeness
meanings.note: 'Quer um café?' is already polite

entry.grammar: In Portugal 'você' aimed at a person can sound pushy; Brazilians use it neutrally. When unsure, use the verb without any pronoun.

cards.trans: articles glued to names and places
cards.note: grammar reference — open 📖 for the full article

meanings.trans: people take articles in speech
meanings.note: A Ana chegou. O Pedro liga depois.

meanings.trans: most countries take one — Portugal doesn't
meanings.note: em Portugal, but no Brasil, na Madeira, nos Açores

meanings.trans: possessives take articles in pt-PT
meanings.note: o meu carro, a tua casa — Brazilian often drops it

entry.grammar: Article before names is warm, not wrong — it is how Portugal talks about people in the room.

meanings.trans: -ão has three plurals: -ões (most), -ães, -ãos
meanings.note: limão→limões, pão→pães, mão→mãos, irmão→irmãos

meanings.trans: -l drops and gains -is
meanings.note: animal→animais, papel→papéis, azul→azuis

meanings.trans: -m becomes -ns
meanings.note: homem→homens, viagem→viagens

entry.grammar: When unsure about an -ão word, -ões wins most often — but the bakery will forgive pãos, once.

meanings.trans: -a words that are masculine: o dia, o mapa, o problema, o clima
meanings.note: Greek imports mostly

meanings.trans: -agem is feminine: a viagem, a garagem, a mensagem
pairs that change meaning with gender
meanings.note: o capital (money) / a capital (city); o guia (person) / a guia (booklet)

entry.grammar: Learn nouns with their article from day one — the deck already does this for you.

meanings.trans: há + period — ago / for
meanings.note: Cheguei há dois anos. Moro cá há dois anos.

meanings.trans: desde + point in time — since
meanings.note: Moro cá desde 2024.

meanings.trans: faz for time is Brazilian — Portugal says há
meanings.note: 'faz dois anos' marks you instantly

entry.grammar: há looks back across a span; desde pins the starting point.

meanings.trans: smallness, affection, softening — often all three
meanings.note: um cafezinho? cá está o troquinho

meanings.trans: softens requests and waits
meanings.note: só um minutinho — expect five

meanings.trans: attaches to anything, adverbs included
meanings.note: devagarinho, agorinha, obrigadinho

entry.grammar: Not baby talk: -inho is register control, and Portugal plays it like an instrument.
